passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Photosynthesis is the process plants use to make their own food.
• Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil.
• Using energy from sunlight, they turn these into sugar.
• Oxygen is released as a by-product.
stem: The student wants to explain photosynthesis to an audience unfamiliar with it. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Photosynthesis is how plants use energy from sunlight to turn carbon dioxide and water into sugar, releasing oxygen.
Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil every day as they grow.
During photosynthesis, oxygen is released into the air as a by-product of the process.
Photosynthesis is a process carried out by plants, and it is essential to nearly all life on Earth, including humans and animals.
steps: An unfamiliar audience needs both what the term means and how the process works.
Only one choice gives the inputs, the energy source and the outputs.
The others give one step, one by-product, or a vague statement without explaining the process.
key: "For an unfamiliar audience" means define the term and explain it completely.
